assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness in the context of the patient's known coronary artery disease
known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
